evals.prompt: I closed claude in a directory that had a running session by mistake, how can I find where I was and what session I was in?
evals.expected_output: Identifies the most recently closed session(s) other than the current one, giving directory, session id, last active time, last thing the user said, and a resume command.

evals.prompt: which claude session was I in when I asked about scott's email? I think it was a week or two ago. give me the command to get back into it
evals.expected_output: Finds the single pipeline-planning session containing the prompt 'Do you have scotts email?', reports its directory, id and last active time, quotes the prompt, and gives a resume command.

evals.prompt: show me all the claude code sessions I've had across all my projects in the last 2 weeks, when each was last active, and the last thing I said in each
evals.expected_output: A table or list covering every project directory with sessions in the window, each with last active time and the last meaningful user prompt (not 'exit'), sorted newest first.
